subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's currentAttemptReplayMetadata contract and server_error retry-before-failover behavior after full-runner proof, or choose another open PR as the canonical fix for the linked issue?
rationale: The patch shape is plausible and source-backed, but it changes retry eligibility across session state and message delivery while adding an optional attempt-result surface; automation cannot safely decide compatibility acceptance or canonical PR selection.
